name: code-snippets
notes: Adapter-authoring probe 2026-08-22: inspected the official WordPress.org Code Snippets 3.9.5 (SHA-256 19bb57c5f677348fb449bc5e8115fb9852d523bc5b4c7021aeab1767169af6f4) and 3.9.6 (SHA-256 ab5822db426858b43d7c010481a87d0eaffb056cc483e93e057d96f6e6fdd4f4) artifacts. Their php/class-db.php, php/snippet-ops.php, and php/flat-files/classes/class-snippet-files.php bytes are identical. php/class-db.php supplies the complete 12-column single-site snippets schema used below; the multisite-only ms_snippets table is outside WPrism's single-site contract.

Snippet rows use mapped identity because the plugin has no stable unique natural key: names are editable and not uniqueness-constrained. name/description/code/tags/scope/priority/active are the portable snippet definition. modified and revision are write-history state, cloud_id binds optional cloud provenance, and condition_id belongs to the plugin's condition subsystem rather than a declared single-site snippet entity graph.

The code_snippet and code_snippet_source shortcodes each accept both id and snippet_id aliases; both point at snippets.id and therefore require the code_snippet token kind. The packaged free 3.9.6 source contains a string check for a code-snippets/source block but no block registration or exact attribute schema, so no block_attrs rule is guessed.

code_snippets_settings mixes portable editor preferences with version-switch controls and enable_flat_files, so the whole settings row stays environment-owned. Provider code-snippets-state clears every plugin-defined cache key for the exact site table, replaces only that table's hashed flat-file directory, delegates reconstruction to the plugin's public Snippet_Files API, and verifies database, fresh plugin API, enabled flag, code-file, and index agreement before returning count/hash-only evidence. The provider refuses multisite and residual active_shared_network_snippets state rather than touching a second identity domain.
